_about: PROPOSAL (Sal, 2026-10-31), read by nothing yet. Starter goals for the first island, taken from TUTORIAL_FIRST_30_MIN.md (the guide's text is the source of truth for hint wording). Format for a coder: `goals` is an ordered list; each goal has `id`, `title`, `hint` (plain text shown in the goal list), `after` (goal ids that must be done first; empty = available at start), `check` (one of: {event, count, what?} fired by the server when the thing happens, {have_item, count} true while the pack holds that many, {made_item, count} counted when a craft finishes, {got_item, count} counted when the player gathers it first-hand (not trades, rewards, refunds or admin gives), {have_item_any, count}), and `stage` (the progression stage; the goal pays that stage's copper from data/items/goal_rewards.json, coins only). A goal completes once and is saved per character (characters.json `goals_done`). Events to emit in server_items.gd: drink, tree_felled, fire_lit, ate_food, placed(what), carcass_worked.

goals.title: Drink at the water
goals.hint: Walk to the water's edge and press E to drink.

goals.title: Gather plant fibre
goals.hint: Nettles and tall grass give plant fibre. Press E on a plant.

goals.title: Twist twine
goals.hint: Open the inventory (I), pick Twine and craft it: 3 plant fibre make 1 twine.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Axe
goals.hint: 1 stone, 1 stick and 2 twine make a Stone - Axe. Put it on the hotbar to use it.

goals.title: Fell a tree
goals.hint: Hold the axe and strike a tree again and again. It breaks into logs, sticks and leaves when it lands.

goals.title: Make a Wooden - Hammer
goals.hint: Cut a wooden block from a felled log, then make a Wooden - Hammer: a wooden block, a stick and a twine. You build everything with it.

goals.title: Light a fire
goals.hint: Make a Campfire (6 sticks, 3 stones) and place it. Put sticks on it with F, then press E near it to light it.

goals.title: Make a hoe
goals.hint: A hoe treads paths and breaks ground for beds. Craft one in the inventory (I): a Wooden - Hoe is 2 sticks and a twine (keep a stone in your pack).

goals.title: Tread a path from camp to the water
goals.hint: Hold the hoe and left click along the ground from your fire towards the water. Or Shift + right click to drop survey markers as you walk and the road builds itself. Paths are faster to walk.

goals.title: Eat something wild
goals.hint: Pick berries or fruit with E and eat them. Put raw meat in the fire with F; cook plants in a pot.

goals.title: Build a lean-to
goals.hint: Hold your Wooden - Hammer, press R and pick Lean-to: 20 sticks, 60 leaves and 6 twine. Build it with the open side towards you.

goals.title: Make a bed
goals.hint: Make a Rough bed from your pack (10 thatch from thatch grass or heather, 4 sticks, 2 twine) and place it in your lean-to.

goals.title: Build a Workbench
goals.hint: Hold your hammer, press R and pick Workbench: 16 sticks, 6 twine and 4 stones. It unlocks better tools.

goals.title: Make a spear
goals.hint: A Wooden - Spear (1 stick, keep a stone) then 2 twine for a Stone - Spear.

goals.title: Make a Stone - Knife and work a kill
goals.hint: 2 stones and a stick make a knife. Strike a rabbit with the spear, then work the body with the knife.

goals.title: Catch a fish
goals.hint: Make a fishing rod (2 sticks, 2 twine) or a fishing net and fish at the pond.

goals.title: Sell to Hob
goals.hint: Hob the trader buys what you pick. Talk to him with E, ask what he sells, and sell him a lot of stones.

goals.title: Fill Hob's order
goals.hint: Ask Hob: Any order for today? Pick what he wants and bring it back. He pays once a day.
